description: The rollout of the proposed Stratos data center in Box Elder County was a failure. The project carries real economic promise, and I am not ready to oppose it. But the current path is not acceptable, and the agency behind it needs reform. Here is where I stand.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Campaign to Elect Cory Maloy
title: Where I Stand on the Stratos Data Center in Box Elder County | The 52 Report
